title: The Brother of Jared Descends
summary: The Lord commands the brother of Jared to descend from the mount and write what he saw. The things are forbidden to come to the children of men until Christ is lifted up upon the cross; King Mosiah keeps them until Christ shows himself to his people.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord commanded the brother of Jared to go down out of the mount from the Lord’s presence and write what he had seen.
The things were forbidden to come unto the children of men until Christ should be lifted up upon the cross.
King Mosiah kept them from coming unto the world until after Christ showed himself to his people.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared can be shown descending a mount while carrying out the command to write.
unspecified_visual_details: The mount’s appearance and the writing materials are not described.
The Lord’s visible appearance is not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: And the Lord commanded the brother of Jared to go down out of the mount
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Narration

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The later restrictions and King Mosiah’s keeping of the things are reported events, not additional present-time scenes.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Christ’s crucifixion or appearance as occurring in this scene.
Do not invent the Lord’s appearance.

title: Made Manifest
summary: After Christ has shown himself to his people, he commands that the things be made manifest.

explicit_facts.text: After Christ had showed himself unto his people, he commanded that the things should be made manifest.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Christ may be shown giving the command, without inventing a specific setting or visual appearance beyond what the text states.
unspecified_visual_details: The place, audience, and physical appearance of Christ in this reported event are not described.

narration.text: after Christ truly had showed himself unto his people

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse reports a command after a prior event; it does not narrate Christ’s appearance itself.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage Christ’s showing himself as a new event in this scene.

title: The Record Hidden Again
summary: The narrator says the people have dwindled in unbelief, that the Lamanites rejected Christ’s gospel, and that he is commanded to hide the things in the earth again.

explicit_facts.text: The people had dwindled in unbelief, and the Lamanites had rejected the gospel of Christ.
The narrator is commanded to hide the things in the earth again.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The narrator may be shown concealing the record in the earth, as this action is explicitly stated.
unspecified_visual_details: The narrator’s appearance and the precise place of concealment are not given.

narration.text: I should hide them up again in the earth.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The dwindling in unbelief and rejection are summarized, not separate present-time scenes.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify the Lamanites in this verse with any later named group or invent individuals among them.

title: The Things Written on Plates
summary: The narrator states that he wrote on plates the things the brother of Jared saw, then sealed the record and its interpretation, including the interpreters, as commanded.

explicit_facts.text: The narrator wrote on plates the things the brother of Jared saw.
The Lord commanded the narrator to write and seal the things and their interpretation; the narrator sealed the interpreters.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The narrator may be shown writing on plates and sealing them, actions explicitly stated in the verses.
unspecified_visual_details: The plates, seal, and interpreters’ appearance are not described.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses describe the narrator’s completed acts and commands received; do not show the brother of Jared’s vision.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the contents of the brother of Jared’s vision.

title: Conditions for Revelation
summary: The Lord says the things shall not go forth to the Gentiles until they repent and become clean before him. He promises to manifest what the brother of Jared saw when they exercise faith and become sanctified.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord says the things shall not go forth unto the Gentiles until they repent of their iniquity and become clean before him.
Jesus Christ says that when they exercise faith as the brother of Jared did and become sanctified, he will manifest what the brother of Jared saw and all his revelations.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The Lord’s words may be conveyed without depicting a visible speaker.
unspecified_visual_details: The Lord’s appearance and the identities and appearances of those addressed are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: They shall not go forth unto the Gentiles until the day that they shall repent of their iniquity, and become clean before the Lord.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: then will I manifest unto them the things which the brother of Jared saw
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The brother of Jared’s vision is referred to, not narrated as a visible event here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the brother of Jared’s vision or the promised revelations as visible events.
Do not invent an appearance for the Lord or identities for the people addressed.

title: The Lord’s Warning
summary: Jesus Christ warns those who contend against the Lord’s word or deny these things. He declares his authority over the heavens and earth and says people will know at the last day that he speaks.
characters: Jesus Christ (speaker; no visible appearance specified)

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ says those who contend against the Lord’s word or deny these things are accursed and will be shown no greater things.
Jesus Christ says the heavens open and shut at his command, the earth shall shake at his word, and its inhabitants shall pass away as by fire.
Jesus Christ says those who do not believe his words do not believe his disciples, and people will know at the last day that he speaks.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The words may be presented as text without depicting a speaker or the events described.
unspecified_visual_details: The speaker’s visible appearance and location are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: and he that shall deny these things, let him be accursed
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: at my word the earth shall shake
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: ye shall know that it is I that speaketh
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The descriptions of the heavens, earthquake, and inhabitants passing away are declarations, not events narrated as occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a present earthquake, fire, opened heavens, or an invented appearance for Jesus Christ.
Do not depict Moroni or other figures not placed in the scene by these verses.

title: The Spirit Persuades to Do Good
summary: Jesus Christ promises manifestations of his Spirit to those who believe his words and teaches that what persuades people to do good is of him.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ promises to visit those who believe his words with manifestations of his Spirit; they will know and bear record.
His Spirit persuades people to do good.
Whatever persuades people to do good is of him.
He says that he is the Father, the light, the life, and the truth of the world.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The teachings can be presented as text labeled “Jesus Christ” without depicting a physical encounter.
unspecified_visual_details: No physical appearance or location is described for Jesus Christ.
No visible form of the Spirit is described.

spoken_dialogue.text: But he that believeth these things which I have spoken, him will I visit with the manifestations of my Spirit, and he shall know and bear record.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: And whatsoever thing persuadeth men to do good is of me;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: For behold, I am the Father, I am the light, and the life, and the truth of the world.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses give teachings and a promise; they do not narrate a visible manifestation.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a manifestation of the Spirit as occurring in this scene.
Do not invent a physical appearance for Jesus Christ or the Spirit.
Do not depict light, life, or truth as a literal supernatural event.

title: Come Unto Me
summary: Jesus Christ invites the Gentiles and the house of Israel to come unto him. He teaches that hidden things will be made known when they rend the veil of unbelief and call upon the Father with broken hearts and contrite spirits.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ invites the Gentiles to come unto him and promises to show the greater things hidden because of unbelief.
Jesus Christ invites the house of Israel and says the Father’s great things will be made manifest to them.
When the house of Israel rends the veil of unbelief and calls upon the Father in Christ’s name with broken hearts and contrite spirits, they will know the Father remembered his covenant.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The invitation may be delivered as off-screen speech over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: No audience or literal veil is specified; the veil is a figure of speech.

spoken_dialogue.text: Come unto me, O ye Gentiles
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: Come unto me, O ye house of Israel
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: when ye shall call upon the Father in my name, with a broken heart and a contrite spirit
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The veil is a metaphor for unbelief, not a literal visible object.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a literal veil being torn.

title: The Record and the Father’s Work
summary: Jesus Christ says his revelations written by John will be unfolded in the eyes of all people, and that receiving this record may let people know the Father’s work has commenced across the land.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ says his revelations written by his servant John will be unfolded in the eyes of all people.
Jesus Christ says receipt of the record may let people know the Father’s work has commenced upon all the face of the land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The teaching may be delivered as off-screen speech over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: John and the people are mentioned but not described as present in a current scene; the land is not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: my revelations which I have caused to be written by my servant John
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: when ye shall receive this record
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The unfolding revelations are promised, not depicted as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show John or an unspecified group of people as physically present.

title: Repent and Believe
summary: Jesus Christ calls the ends of the earth to repent, come unto him, believe in his gospel, and be baptized in his name; he teaches that signs will follow those who believe in his name.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus Christ calls the ends of the earth to repent, come unto him, believe in his gospel, and be baptized in his name.
Jesus Christ says believers who are baptized shall be saved, those who do not believe shall be damned, and signs shall follow believers in his name.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The call may be delivered as off-screen speech over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: No listeners, baptism, or signs are described as occurring in this scene.

spoken_dialogue.text: repent all ye ends of the earth, and come unto me
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

spoken_dialogue.text: he that believeth and is baptized shall be saved
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Baptism and signs are taught, not narrated as visible events here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage a baptism or signs as present events.

title: Faithful at the Last Day
summary: Jesus Christ declares that the faithful at the last day will be lifted up to dwell in the kingdom prepared for them, and concludes, “Amen.”

explicit_facts.text: Those found faithful unto Christ’s name at the last day will be lifted up to dwell in the kingdom prepared for them from the foundation of the world.
Jesus Christ says he has spoken it and concludes with Amen.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The promise may be delivered as off-screen speech over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The kingdom’s appearance and the appearance of any faithful people are not described.

spoken_dialogue.text: blessed is he that is found faithful unto my name at the last day
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The promised future dwelling is not described visually.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict an undescribed kingdom or its inhabitants.
